aboutHeading: Electrical & Fire Safety in Fitzroy North
aboutText: JAE Electrical and Compliance Services are a Hobart-based, family-owned business specialising in electrical and fire safety systems. With a commitment to excellence, we have been serving the Fitzroy North community and greater Hobart area for years. Our dedicated and professional technicians provide high standards and efficiency, ensuring environmentally responsible solutions for all compliance needs.
servicesText: From thermal imaging to exit and emergency lighting, JAE Electrical and Compliance Services cover a wide range of electrical safety needs. Our team in Fitzroy North provides test and tag, RCD testing, and fire system inspections to keep your property compliant and safe.

services.title: Thermal Imaging Services
services.desc: Utilise advanced thermal imaging to detect electrical faults and prevent hazards, ensuring system reliability.

services.desc: Professional test and tag services for all portable electrical appliances, meeting Australian standards.

services.title: RCD Testing and Certification
services.desc: Comprehensive RCD testing to guarantee safety devices function correctly, protecting against electrical shocks.

services.title: Exit and Emergency Lighting
services.desc: Installation and maintenance of exit and emergency lighting systems for compliance and safety in emergencies.

services.title: Electrical Safety Inspections
services.desc: Thorough inspections of electrical systems to identify risks and ensure compliance with regulations.

services.title: Fire Safety Systems
services.desc: Expert maintenance and installation of fire safety systems, integrated with electrical services for complete protection.
